title: RAW UNREVIEWED: source-written Viola synonyms require a fixed lexical channel for fochor
summary: An independently dated primary entry that labels a Viola illustration and explicitly writes two synonyms could constrain a proposed fochor name, but only after one shared, externally established transcription or translation channel accounts for several unrelated named plants. A one-off phonetic resemblance is not evidence. Source, channel, and matching target capacity are all unverified.

design.mechanism: One fixed source-to-target name transformation maps several source-owned plant names and their synonyms to whole Voynich name forms.
design.unit: Complete primary synonym entries and complete already admitted Herbal heads, including f9v and unrelated plant controls.
design.contrast: shared predeclared lexical transformation versus opportunistic resemblance to one Viola synonym
design.prediction: A transformation fixed without f9v gives the source-written Viola synonym relation at fochor while preserving non-Viola control names; otherwise the lexical channel has no support.
design.scope: Raw source-acquisition idea; no candidate transformation or owner presently asserted.
